scripts.db: npm run prisma:deploy && npm run prisma:status && npm run seed && npm run prisma:studio
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w lms-backend" "npm run dev -w lms-frontend"
scripts.dev:v: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:v -w lms-backend" "npm run dev:v -w lms-frontend"
scripts.prod: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run prod -w lms-backend" "npm run prod -w lms-frontend"
scripts.prod:v: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run prod:v -w lms-backend" "npm run prod:v -w lms-frontend"
scripts.prisma:status: npm exec -w lms-backend -- prisma migrate status
scripts.prisma:deploy: npm exec -w lms-backend -- prisma migrate deploy
